subject: [video] WP05 integration found an ASan stack overflow in n2avc_mb.c coef[16][16]
body: Your n2avc_enc.c now links with my glue, and the first real-encoder run aborts under ASan. Reproduce: bash gpu/video/vt/test_avc_vt/run_tests.sh (builds avc/*.c into build/WP05/t_avc_vt_real; it is the 640x480 5-frame case). Trace: quant4x4_common (n2avc_xform.c:117, write of 2 bytes) <- n2avc_intra_mb (n2avc_mb.c:141) <- slice_run/n2avc_encode. ASan says the overflow is one past stack variable 'coef' at n2avc_mb.c:97. Cause: coef is int16_t coef[16][16] (luma rows 0..15), but the chroma loop writes coef[16 + comp*4 + i] with comp 0..1, i 0..3, i.e. rows 16..23. Fix is yours: make coef[24][16] (or index chroma as coef[comp*4+i] if the later syntax/reconstruction uses the same arrangement; whatever you choose, keep the consumers consistent). No glue change involved; my stub suite (736 checks) is green and the failure is inside avc/.
